I am new to propane BBQ and have found the Weber to be easy to use and it produces very tasty grilled items.  I have the iGrill3 also and believe it is the major factor for achieving good results. 

While exploring the Weber web site I discovered the possibility of smoking.  So I acquired a smoking box and a selection of wood chips.  My first experiment was not very successful because I could not get the Weber to maintain a low temperature (250 degrees) during the one hour of smoking for a pair of steaks.   I had one burner totally off and the other turned to its minimum setting and the temp was around 350 degrees.  So the meat cooked too quickly and did not absorb enough smoke flavor.   I have submitted a request to Weber customer support for help in understanding how to do the low temp. smoking but have not yet received any response.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this issue. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:



-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.



-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.



-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.



-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.



-Close the grill lid.



-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes. 

This is how you would want to light the grill each time. If you continue to have an issue please contact our support team for further assistance. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is replacing a Charbroil that I bought on sale around 10 years ago. I'm pleased that it lasted 10 years before falling apart, so I was tempted to go the cheap route again. The problem, though, is even when it was working, it never cooked well. The meat had to be right over the burners or it would take a really long time to cook. So I decided to spend more on a Weber based on the reputation.

I bought this unassembled so I can fit it in my car to bring home. Even so, the box was too big for my trunk, so I needed to take the parts out of the box to fit. Once I managed to get it home, it was a breeze to assemble. I don't remember ever seeing assembly instructions that were so clear. It was actually an enjoyable experience. 

And it works just as I expected a Weber to. The ignition lights effortlessly, unlike the frustrating click buttons that I was used to. And there is a scale that shows how much propane is left in the tank, another useful perk. The whole thing seems more solid than any of my other grills ever did. I can tell this will last a long time. And the cooking...it is perfect. The cooking surface is small compared to other grills for sale, but the whole surface is heated evenly and therefore not wasted. So even though this is a little smaller than my Charbroil, I can cook a whole lot of more food at once. And with the thermometer and burner knobs that actually control the temperature, I can cook much better than I could with the Charbroil. 

The only problem was the price. It is very expensive, and a luxury purchase. If it is worth it depends on how much you use it.
Results.Title: Great quality luxury purchase

Hello! Congratulations on your new grill! 
If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips:

At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.

Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.

Depending on your location again, we would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming. 

Please remember that the quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Thanks!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Prior to this purchase, I owned a standard, moderate priced grill.  It got the job done, but parts rusted and had a lot of flair up problems.  I never really knew when to change out the tank.

With the Weber grill, I feel like I am in the lap of luxury.  The grill is solid, has even heat,  an automatic starter that is instant, and a meter that monitors the amount of propane used.

Assembly was precise, but  the grill is well engineered. It feels sturdy .  I really liked the small profile in my garage.

I was very glad I spent the extra money to buy a quality product.
Results.Title: A superior grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
My last Weber Grill lasted for almost 18 years and I am an all year around user, and sometimes use it twice a day. Both my children own Weber Grills. We are all very happy with the way they grill. I have one concern about my new grill. I feel is a bit of a safety hazard. The design of the handle can cause a slight burn of your hand. You must be extremely careful not to touch or brush against the ends of the handle. The heat resistant handle material on my previous Weber made the turn 
at each end which made it much safer. Other than that I would have given it a 5+.
Results.Title: Love my Weber, with one word of caution!!!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
